subject: Express palletization + tent split — dropoff, crate labels, and kitting checklist
messages:
From: Ellie Harper <ellie@promoplus.co>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@parcelpro.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial quote + palletization option for Redwood giveaway crates

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is an expedited quote for express palletization and a split-tent delivery (two drop points at the venue for expo booth and sponsor tent). Key notes:

- Lead time: 5 business days for printed items; 3 business days for kitting and palletization if stock is confirmed today.
- Palletization: we propose 10 crates (1100x1100mm Euro pallets) plus 2 small pick crates for VIP swag.
- Tent split: items for sponsor tent must be labeled with the tent code (TENT-B) for the on-site ops team.
- Express freight surcharge: +18% on top of standard freight (includes same-day manifest printing and priority dock).

Attachments: promo_swatch_v7.pdf (color proofs), express_waybill_manifest_4471.pdf (sample).

I can start printing the crate labels using the crate_label_template.csv if you send over final SKU allocations. If anything is urgent, Diego at ParcelPro is CC'd — they handle dock scheduling at the venue.

Best,
Ellie Harper
Account Lead, PromoPlus Co.
[Attachment: promo_swatch_v7.pdf (PDF)]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Harper <ellie@promoplus.co>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@parcelpro.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial quote + palletization option for Redwood giveaway crates

Ellie —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the proofs. A couple quick clarifications before we lock the SKU list:

1) Can you confirm the pallet height limit you used for the quote? We need to keep hand-unloadable heights for venue staff (target ~1.2m).
2) For the tent split, we'll need 1 full pallet + 1 small pick crate flagged for TENT-B (VIP materials), and the rest staged to Booth 421.
3) Please include foam separators between enamel pins and embroidered items — previous show had pin abrasion.

I uploaded an initial SKU allocation to the Drive link (PromoPlus folder) but will paste the final counts below by EOD:
- Promo tee (S-XL): 600
- Enamel pin: 1,000
- Branded notebook: 300
- VIP lanyard: 150 (goes to TENT-B pick crate)

If you can confirm pallet height and the ability to print tent-coded crate labels, I’ll approve the express freight.

Thanks —
Aisha
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@parcelpro.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Ellie Harper <ellie@promoplus.co>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial quote + palletization option for Redwood giveaway crates

Hi team —

Quick logistics note from the venue side (Conference Hall Dock Ops):

- Max pallet height for hand-unloading at the expo dock is 1.25m; we recommend 1.15m to account for shrink-wrap.
- We have two on-site drop points: Dock A (for Booth 421 crates) and Event West Gate (for TENT-B). Dock A access window: Jan 26, 08:00–11:00. West Gate access window: Jan 26, 11:30–13:00.
- All pallets must have the following visible on the long side: company name, crate ID, tent/booth code, contact number.

Diego Ramos
National Ops, ParcelPro Logistics
[Attachment: venue_dock_instructions.pdf (PDF)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ellie Harper <ellie@promoplus.co>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@parcelpro.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Express palletization + tent split — dropoff, crate labels, and kitting checklist

Thanks Diego / Ellie —

I created a quick on-site kitting checklist and updated the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3-promo-kitting-4471

On-site ops checklist (short):
- Confirm manifest at Dock A upon arrival; match crate IDs to manifest.
- TENT-B pick crate must be isolated and kept off the main pallet until West Gate arrival.
- VIP lanyards to be bagged in sets of 5 with label "VIP-L" and put in small pick crate.
- Crew contact at venue: Marcus Klein (local Redwood lead) — phone: +1 (415) 555-0189.

Also attached is a CSV-ready crate label template (crate_label_template.csv) with a sample for the first two pallets. Ellie — can you populate the SKU-level weight per package so we can confirm pallet counts?

-Chloe
Event Production Coordinator
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ellie Harper <ellie@promoplus.co>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@parcelpro.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 17:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Express palletization + tent split — dropoff, crate labels, and kitting checklist

Quick operational update from the field — arriving at the venue to supervise Sunday morning pickup. Notes:

- Ellie: please confirm final crate label CSV by 23:59 PST tonight so we can print adhesives and pre-apply at the kitting station.
- Vendor to confirm that foam separators are included and that VIP lanyard sets are already bagged (we don't have time for rework on-site).
- Diego: we will need a scanner-enabled manifest at each dock (PDF + barcode) for faster reconciliation. If ParcelPro can provide, please include in the final manifest.
- Ben: I’ll hand off the local courier contact for any immediate deviances — Ben, please be on call Jan 26 07:30–14:00 PST.

If labels and manifests are confirmed tonight I’ll mark the pallets as green for pickup.

-Marcus
Field Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0189
